# Fixtures for `leveldb_table` (LevelDB / RocksDB sorted table)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0, for a fictitious harbour (Saltmere Harbour): made with RocksDB's ldb and LevelDB through plyvel. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/db.sh`.
